title: Athena Reveals Herself at Pylos
part: The four books with no filmed scene (3, 7, 15, 20): Book 3's key scene, filmed for the first time
hypothesis: The goddess's change reads in LEGO without a morph: Mentor is there on one side of a cut and on the other a sea-eagle rises from where he stood and flies off over the sea, the two men's eyes and heads following it. Honest about it: the change itself is not shown (the poem tells it in one line: she flew away in the form of an eagle).

result: Kept as take 2. The change reads: Mentor is there, then a brown sea-eagle as big as a man goes up from where he stood beside the boy, the wide holds it climbing over the two men and the heifers, and the next shot is the two faces turned up after it before Nestor turns to the boy. Mentor's closes are near eye level. Loose: in the look-up shot Nestor's hand is at his face (his speech's gesture has begun: he speaks 'Dear boy' while still watching the sky); in the wide the men are small (the frame is sized for the bird's climb); the hand Nestor takes does not meet the boy's; the change itself is still a cut (as the hypothesis said), not a transformation.

faults: Mentor gone on the cut at 24.6 s and the sea-eagle (0.22 scale) a speck at the frame's top edge for a few drawings: never seen rising, no shot following it
Mentor's closes at 4-8 s and 13-16 s from over his head (the solver's over-the-crowd elevation, chosen because the eye-level cameras on the line's side were blocked)

variable_take2: The eagle's scale 0.5 (odyssey/keyframes/OD-B03-S05.json), its path climbing first (P1 70 units over his head in 1.2 s, then away over the sea), its wingbeat drawings extended to the 4.4-s flight; Nestor and Telemachus hold their places 2.2 s longer (RETIME of their move into K2) and watch it go; the plan: a wide from the sea side that must hold three points of the rise (solve.js need), a low two-shot of the two faces turned up (26.6-28.6 s), and noHigh on every shot but the wide.
